synthesis:draft.headline: Other-region AEMO market notices reported inter‑regional transfer, constraint and line‑outage activity referencing the V‑SA interconnector around 2026-07-31 and did not verbatim report an 'SA1 price spike'.

document_statements.paraphrase: The VIC notice market_notice_144694#0 reports a short‑notice outage of South Morang‑Sydenham No.1 500 kV line and that the invoked constraint set(s) include V‑SA; the notice's local clock time is 2026-07-31 11:00 AEST (UTC+1000).

The VIC notice market_notice_144688#0 reports that AEMO invoked automated constraint set CA_SYDS_597B5710 from the notice's local time 2026-07-29 01:30 AEST (UTC+1000) and that this set contains V‑SA.

The VIC notice market_notice_144708#0 reports a short‑notice outage of SYTS MLTS 2 line/SMTS 2 line CB with invoked constraint set(s) that list V‑SA; the notice's local clock time is 2026-08-01 17:15 AEST (UTC+1000).

The NSW notice market_notice_144695#0 reports that the planned outage of Directlink (all 3 cables) was completed and Directlink returned to service at the notice's local time 2026-07-31 14:30 AEST (UTC+1000).
The QLD notice market_notice_144689#0 reports a unit non‑conformance (Unit: LILYSF1, Duration: 29/07/2026 12:40 to 29/07/2026 12:45, Amount: 56 MW) and does not mention an 'SA1 price spike'.
